basic_info.description: A diamond in the rough, 734 Elizabeth Street is located in the heart of Noe Valley. Just steps away from 24th Street, the property is close to shopping, dining, schools, public transportation, and easy access to 280 and 101 freeways. Whether you want to walk, drive, or take the bus, this location offers you flexible means to get to your final destination. The sellers offer a great opportunity for a contractor or home buyer to develop this property into a Noe Valley gem. After being owned by the same family for 80 years, the property needs love and imagination to return it to its original grandeur. This home features 6 rooms and 1 bath. The large front yard receives Southern exposure, and the backyard receives plenty of natural sunlight from dawn to dusk.  Property is being sold in its physical As Is condition with no warranties implied or expressed by the sellers and/or Mullins & Company.
